prediction_target: cross-sectional rank of four-week relative return

outer_walk_forward.training: expanding history strictly before test year
outer_walk_forward.embargo: training labels must end before test-year start

inner_selection.score: mean monthly rank IC minus 0.01 times top-five turnover proxy
inner_selection.selection_scope: best configuration independently within each model family

ensemble.members: best inner-selected configuration from each family

negative_controls: labels shuffled within each training decision month
features shuffled within each decision month

promotion_gates.sharpe_10bps: greater than fixed factor baseline and frozen winner on common period
promotion_gates.maximum_drawdown_10bps: no worse than frozen winner on common period
promotion_gates.controls: real predictions beat shuffled-label and random-feature controls
